subject: Collecting data from survey. How to retrieve the database

messages.author: 4c89d90daab634b4
messages.subject: Collecting data from survey. How to retrieve the database
parts: My intention is to make a survey using shinyapps. The app stores the answers in a file, and I could retrieve this file using downloadHandler, however I don't want this information to be available to every user. Is there any other alternative?

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Collecting data from survey. How to retrieve the database
parts:
A possible alternative is for you to have a button that will push that file to a location that only you have access to.  Maybe you can write the data into a database table, or to an S3 bucket on Amazon?

-Tareef
